info.name: Qeet Notify API (v1)
info.description:
Qeet Notify — multi-channel transactional notification platform.

This collection covers every /v1 operation across the four OpenAPI 3.1 specs in api/openapi/ (messaging, subscribers, deliverability, operations) plus the health probes.

Auth: set the collection variable `apiKey` to a `qn_live_…` key; it is sent as the `X-Qeet-Api-Key` header on every request (scopes: full = all · read = GET-only · send = POST /v1/events only). Health, unsubscribe, and provider webhooks are unauthenticated.

Set `baseUrl` (API, default http://localhost:8080) and `sseUrl` (SSE stream, default http://localhost:8082).

Returns the tenant's event-family memberships — the sibling trigger events grouped into a single logical "story" so cross-event semantic deduplication (Module 16.5) can suppress duplicate sends to a subscriber. Ordered by family_key, then event_name.

item.name: Add an event to a family

request.description: Declares that event_name belongs to family_key. Idempotent — re-declaring an existing membership is a no-op that still returns 201.

item.name: Remove an event from a family

request.description: Removes the (family_key, event_name) membership. The pair may be given in the JSON body or as ?family_key=&event_name= query parameters.

DPDP right-to-erasure — nulls all PII, empties push tokens/metadata, and marks the subscriber deleted.
DPDP Data-Subject-Rights export: all personal data held for one subscriber — decrypted profile PII, the current preference matrix, and the full consent history.
Returns the subscriber's channel+category opt-in matrix.
Upserts one or more channel+category opt-in states; each change is also appended to the consent ledger. Items with an empty channel are skipped.
Returns a subscriber's append-only DPDP consent trail, newest first — used for Data-Subject-Rights access / export requests.

Appends a consent change to the immutable ledger and mirrors it into the mutable preferences matrix (same transaction), so the opt-in/out takes effect on the next send. Actor and IP are captured from the request.
Returns a subscriber's registered push tokens.

Registers (or refreshes) a push token on a subscriber. The token is
de-duplicated by value, so re-registration updates the provider/platform
rather than creating a duplicate. For provider "webpush", token is the
browser subscription's endpoint URL and p256dh/auth (both required)
carry the subscription's client keys.

Lists notification jobs that exhausted their delivery retries and were
dead-lettered, newest first. A drainer copies each NOTIFY_DLQ entry into
a queryable table so failed sends can be inspected and replayed.
Get a dead-lettered job
Marks a pending dead-letter discarded without redriving it.

Republishes the original job onto its channel subject for another
delivery attempt and marks it redriven. This is the supported replay
path for exhausted-retry failures.

query.description: Filter by registered carrier (e.g. airtel, jio, all).

request.description:
Lists the tenant's DLT / WhatsApp BSP template registrations,
newest first, optionally filtered by channel, carrier, or status.

DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology) templates are mandatory for SMS in India.
Every outbound SMS body must match a pre-registered DLT template regex. `channel`
defaults to `sms` and `category` to `transactional`.

Updates a DLT template's approval status, principal-entity ID, or
sender ID. Only supplied fields are changed.
Delete DLT template

Lists registered National Do-Not-Call (DND) entries as SHA-256 phone
hashes. This is national reference data — an entry applies to every
sender, so it is not tenant-scoped.

item.name: Register a phone on the DND list

request.description:
Adds a phone to the national DND list (source=manual). Idempotent. Note:
this is national data — the entry suppresses promotional SMS for every
tenant, matching TRAI DND semantics.

query.description: Optional DLT category; defaults to any

request.description: Reports whether a phone is on the DND list. Safe, read-only.
Lists the tenant's provider configs (credentials never returned).
Create provider configuration

Updates provider priority, active state, and/or credentials. Only
supplied fields are changed.
Delete provider configuration
List suppressions

Suppresses future sends to an address on a channel. The plaintext value
is hashed (SHA-256) with the same scheme the channel workers use when
checking suppression, so the entry takes effect immediately. Idempotent:
re-adding the same value updates its reason.
Removes an address from the suppression list, re-enabling sends.
List sender domains

Registers a sending domain (unverified until checked). Idempotent —
re-registering an existing domain updates its DKIM selector.

item.name: Get a sender domain + DNS records to publish

request.description:
Returns the sender domain plus the DNS record names to publish for

Delete a sender domain
Resolves the domain's TXT records and updates verification state.
Email bounce and complaint rates from delivery_events with a status against the Gmail/Yahoo/Microsoft 2024+ thresholds (Module 23.3).

Lists the tenant's inbound messages, newest first (limit 100). The

Per-tenant compliance posture across regimes (TRAI DLT, WhatsApp/Meta templates, NDNC registry, DPDP consent, email auth), each with a red/amber/green status. A regime whose data source is not yet available reads as `unknown`, never as compliant; the overall status is the worst known pane.

Runs the deterministic send gates (DLT template match, NDNC scrubbing, promotional window, subscriber consent) for a proposed send and reports whether it would be allowed, with a per-check breakdown. Checks that cannot be evaluated return `unknown` and do not block.
Returns the tenant's dedicated-IP warmup pools, newest first (Module 23.2). A warmup pool governs the daily send ceiling for an email stream while a dedicated IP ramps its reputation.
Creates a warmup pool. warmup_started_on defaults to today; a pool starts active and un-throttled. name must be unique per tenant.
Delete an IP warmup pool
Returns the computed warmup plan for a pool: the day-in-warmup, today's daily cap (reduced when the pool is complaint-throttled), sends so far today, and remaining headroom.
Aggregate delivery funnel totals for the authenticated tenant, counted from delivery_events by event type. Takes no query parameters.
Open/click/delivery rates and a 0–100 engagement score per channel (Module 28.1/28.2), derived from delivery_events. Optional ?since filter.
Per-subscriber engagement score
A 0–100 composite per template blending open/click rates against spam-complaint and bounce penalties (Module 28.4).
Unified, ordered per-tenant delivery lifecycle events (Module 26.3) for warehouse sync and auditing. Filterable by notification, event type, and time range.
